subject: Agent06 renderer minimum: keep one frozen-frame AGSL optical engine; fix domain/filtering before new effects
body: HEAD 413d4a7. Renderer minimum for Alpha3: retain one deterministic frozen transition frame + one AGSL glass optical surface. Confirmed source defects: DuoShader targets MAX_TILT=89.5 while duo_unfold.agsl clamps 60 (cover geometry plateaus from ~13.57->20deg hinge; inner from 20->~70.10deg); FoldOverlayView BitmapShader is RuntimeShader input with default filter mode, which Android defines as NEAREST in this case. First debug A/B should only align MAX_TILT=60 and explicitly set FILTER_MODE_LINEAR. Do not revive LiveBlurSurface. Next, measure the fixed 32-iteration blur kernel at 120Hz; only then test 16/12 taps + bounded radius. The full-res FlatView -> half-res FoldView hard switch at FLAT_EPSILON is another source-level onset-pop risk and should receive a narrow-crossfade A/B only if visible. HardwareBuffer zero-copy is later capture optimization, not renderer prerequisite. Agent05's direct SurfaceControl host is compatible: SurfaceControl owns presentation, AGSL owns optics. Agent09's one-canonical-frame direction is also compatible.
